# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest `main` branch version of Enterprise RAG AI Assistant is supported for security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report vulnerabilities to the security team at `security@example.com`. Please include:
- A description of the issue and its potential impact.
- Step-by-step instructions (or a proof-of-concept) to reproduce the vulnerability.

You will receive an acknowledgment within 24 hours and regular status updates until resolution.
